title: The Open Current
author: Bram Joubert
blurb: Hazel Almeida, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the concession permits expire.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
